business_problem: build and distribute an industrial AI platform that could combine factory data, manufacturing context, and advanced models quickly enough to improve efficiency and compete globally.
solution_summary: O3sigma uses Snowflake, Apache Iceberg, Microsoft Azure Blob Storage, Cortex AI, Cortex Analyst, RelationalAI, and Snowflake Marketplace to deliver a native industrial AI application for factories. Manufacturing data stored in Apache Parquet tables and Azure Blob is connected through Apache Iceberg into a single Snowflake data lake, where semantic context and AI services support composite models across equipment and process data instead of isolated point solutions. Cortex AI, Cortex Analyst, and RelationalAI power natural-language search and explainable user-facing insights on top of the centralized data, while Snowflake Marketplace gives O3sigma a distribution channel for its native app. The same foundation supported early pilots such as NASA C-MAPSS benchmarking and customer deployments across more than 40 factories, helping the team fine-tune models quickly and turn optimization results into new revenue.
